domain.name: Embodied / Physical-IoT
domain.description: Software with a physical or spatial footprint — hardware pairing, proximity, ambient presence, or AR overlays on the real world.

governance.name: Passkey-Gated
governance.description: Every state-changing action requires a fresh biometric/WebAuthn proof — the passkey floor.

latency.name: Real-Time (<100ms)
latency.description: Synchronous interaction loop where the agent must respond within a frame or a breath — games, AR, voice.
examples: AR overlay that tracks head movement

pitch: A embodied / physical-iot governed by passkey-gated, operating at real-time (<100ms) latency.
